_fixture.note: Hand-authored citation decision table for the M003.2 retrieval-backed compiler. Every host is a reserved .invalid documentation name, so nothing here resolves or was captured from the internet. The documents are invented prose whose term distribution makes each expected binding and each refusal explainable; the fixture is a binding rule, not a measurement of a live corpus. Bodies are extracted through the M002.4 boundary and stored through the M002.5 store before they are indexed.

documents.why: Holds the only passage that contains all of espresso, brewed and pressure.
documents.body:
Espresso Brewing

Espresso is brewed by forcing hot water through finely ground coffee under pressure.

An espresso extraction usually finishes in about thirty seconds.

documents.why: Shares the phrase 'hot water' with the espresso guide, so the ambiguous-quote refusal is observable.
documents.body:
Steeping

Tea is steeped in hot water, not brewed under pressure.

Green tea prefers cooler water.

documents.why: Holds the only passage that contains all of filtered, water and taste.
documents.body:
Water Quality

Filtered water improves the taste of both coffee and tea.

Water that is too hot scalds the grounds.

documents.why: Holds the only passage that contains all of nine, bars, espresso and pressure.
documents.body:
Pressure

Nine bars is a common espresso pressure.

Pressure drives the extraction, so weak coffee means weak pressure.
